key_insight: Capacity-aware online conformal risk control (CA-OCRC) adapts prediction sets when feedback is delayed or lost because tracking resources are limited.
clinical_relevance: For medical imaging AI, this approach could support uncertainty quantification when outcome feedback arrives late and only some predictions can be tracked.
method: Randomly samples a proxy delay to decide whether and how long to track each prediction.
Uses inverse probability weighting to compensate for missing feedback.
Optimizes tracking policies using risk bounds for arbitrary and stochastic delays.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments in medical imaging, natural language processing, computer vision, and wireless communications, but provides no dataset details or numerical results.
watch_item: Long-term risk guarantees do not establish per-patient safety; clinical deployment would require validation under local feedback delays and tracking constraints.
paper_title: Capacity-Constrained Delayed Feedback for Online Conformal Risk Control
